bagPolicy.summary: Ford Idaho Center Arena does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The Ford Idaho Center offers 4,000 on-site parking spaces with a fee of $10 per vehicle. Prepaid parking is available via ParkMobile, and reserving in advance is recommended to guarantee a spot. RV parking is available for $40, but overnight parking is not permitted.

rideshare.note: Your go to pick up and drop off rideshare and Lyft location for quick convienence.

concessions.note: Ford Idaho Center Arena offers a variety of food and beverage options, including classic concessions like hot dogs, pretzels, and cheeseburgers, as well as specialty items from food trucks such as Coned Pizza and Maui Wowi smoothies. The venue is cashless, accepting only debit, credit, and mobile payments.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Ford Idaho Center Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Ford Idaho Center Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Ford Idaho Center Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Ford Idaho Center Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
